battle.name: 羅馬奴隸起義
battle.theater: 西西里東岸墨西拿至阿格里真圖姆
battle.brief: 公元前135年，西西里島墨西拿待售市集裡的奴工脫逃起事，吸納島上莊園勞工與奇里乞亞海盜，席捲島東南，終於前132年被大法官魯皮利烏斯圍城平定。卡面的秦連弩是中國戰國末年的連發弩機，並未出現在西西里；它在此標示的，是「以連續箭幕壓住牆下蟻附之師」的守城兵器位置。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 公元前135年爆發的這場衝突，發生在羅馬共和國直轄行省西西里島的內部，交戰的雙方不是國家而是兩個陣營。一方是起義聯盟：核心是梅西納城待售市集裡脫逃的奴工，島上各處莊園、礦場與鹽田的勞動者陸續加入，奇里乞亞海盜則以僱傭兵身分參與，帶來船隻與掠奪能力，使起義從陸上騷擾升級為能切斷沿海補給的武裝力量。首領由脫逃者自行推舉，埃努斯自稱王，克利昂與梅加魯斯分任軍事首領，號令分立而互不隸屬，這種鬆散結構正是起義方能迅速擴張卻難以協調的原因。另一方是羅馬共和國：西西里總督與駐島部隊先行應對，元老院收到急報後派遣大法官級將領率援軍登陸，野戰部隊由常備軍團與輔助軍團組成，另有艦隊沿東岸巡弋，控制墨西拿等港口的糧秣出入。島內的希臘化城市與拉丁盟邦並非參戰方，而是以提供情報、維持治安或請求保護的方式被捲入。整場衝突沒有外國勢力直接介入，性質是行省內部的叛亂與鎮壓。
countriesEn: The conflict that broke out in 135 BC was not a war between states but a large-scale armed revolt inside the Roman Republic's directly administered province of Sicily, and it therefore pitted two camps against each other rather than two nations. On one side stood the rebel alliance: at its core were the enslaved labourers who broke out of the slave market at Messana, joined by workers from the island's estates, mines and salt pans who came over one by one, and by Cilician pirates who entered as mercenaries and supplied the ships and the raiding capacity that turned the rising from a rural disturbance into an armed force able to cut coastal supply lines. The leaders were chosen by the runaways themselves: Eunus took the title of king, while Cleon and Megarus served as military commanders, so command was divided and not subordinated to a single centre, a structure that let the revolt expand quickly but coordinate badly. On the other side stood the Roman Republic: the governor of Sicily and the garrison already on the island responded first, and after the senate received the emergency appeal it dispatched a praetor-level commander with reinforcements, the field army made up of a regular legion and auxiliary troops, plus a fleet patrolling the eastern coast and controlling the flow of grain and stores through Messana and the other ports. The Hellenic cities of the island and the Latin communities did not take part as belligerents; they were drawn in by providing intelligence, keeping order or asking for protection. No foreign power intervened directly at any point: the whole affair remained a provincial rebellion and its suppression.
people: 起義方的關鍵人物可以分三層。第一層是號稱王的埃努斯，一個敘利亞出身、在島上莊園做過奴工的人，他善於用預言與宗教語言維持追隨者的士氣，在軍事上則把首領職銜分授給屬下，形成一套名義上存在、實際上鬆散的權力結構。第二層是真正帶兵打仗的克利昂，出身奇里乞亞，在海盜與奴工之間的灰色地帶活動，負責率領脫逃隊伍夜襲、登山、破莊園。第三層是梅加魯斯以及奇里乞亞海盜的首領們；海盜首領掌握船隊，專打沿海運輸線，羅馬援軍的遲緩與海上航線的騷擾直接相關。羅馬方面的關鍵人物是西西里總督蓋約·曼利烏斯，他最初的拖延與兵力不足直接害死了自己：公元前134年他被引到溫泉地帶的埋伏中被殺，伏擊的關鍵在於把羅馬官員從城內引出來。真正收拾局面的是大法官普布利奧·魯皮利烏斯，他帶著包含一個軍團的援兵登陸，攻下陶羅梅尼翁，再圍阿格里真圖姆，最終生擒埃努斯、處死克利昂。幕後還有西班牙戰線的西庇奧·埃米利安諾斯、元老院內部對是否用兵意見分歧的派系，以及西西里掌握大莊園的公民地主，這些人共同推動了整個決策過程。
peopleEn: Three layers of key figures can be distinguished among the rebels. The first is the bearer of the royal title, Eunus, a Syrian who had worked as a slave on an island estate; he was skilled at sustaining his followers' morale with prophecy and religious language, and in military terms he distributed the rank of commander among his lieutenants, producing a kingship that was real in title but loose in practice. The second is the man who actually led the fighting, Cleon, a Cilician who moved in the grey zone between piracy and bondage, leading the runaways in night attacks, in the climb into the hills and in the breaking up of the estates. The third is Megarus together with the leaders of the Cilician pirates, who commanded the ships and struck at the coastal transport line; the presence of the pirates is directly connected to the slowness of the Roman relief and the harassment of the sea lanes. The decisive figure on the Roman side was the governor of Sicily, Gaius Manlius, whose hesitation and shortage of troops killed him: in 134 BC he was drawn out of his city into an ambush among the hot springs and killed, the ambush turning on the trick of luring a Roman official away from his defences. The man who actually settled the matter was the praetor Publius Rupilius, who landed with a relief force containing a legion, took Tauromenium, then besieged Agrigentum, and in the end captured Eunus alive and executed Cleon. Behind the scenes stood Scipio Aemilianus and the Spanish front, the senatorial faction split over whether to take the field, and the citizen landowners of Sicily who held the great estates; together they drove the whole decision process forward.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩是中國戰國末期的連發弩機，年代比西西里起義早三百餘年。它的結構是弩機把拉力存起來，上弦張力之後踩下扳機即發，機匣之內可以預置數支乃至數十支矢，一踩一發連續射出。放進這場戰爭，是因為它標示出這件兵器在體系中的位置：它不是野戰的步戰兵器，也不是破甲兵器，而是架在城牆上、專門對付蟻附攻城之師的守城兵器，負責在牆下鋪出持續不斷的箭幕，封住雲梯與攻城塔的接近路線。中國的守城論述把連弩與拒馬、堞牆、矢石並列，重視的是射速與持續性而非單發的破甲力，這是一個以城牆為主戰場的國家才會發展出來的裝備思路。西西里沒有這種弩機，起義方與羅馬方面實際使用的是另一套東西：奴工一方以莊園工具、削尖木棍、魚叉、獵矛、角鏃與農用鐵器為主，在梅西納奪得的角鬥場兵器是其中最好的一批；島上投石索手的傳統在雙方都存在，羅馬軍中編有專門的投石手。羅馬步兵則是全套裝備：重標槍 pilum 配圓盾、持大盾的持矛兵、短劍、頭盔與鎖子甲；攻城時使用弩炮、投石機與配重式砲床，圍攻阿格里真圖姆時，砲擊城牆與城內建築是主要手段之一。雙方都靠海運維持補給，起義方靠奇里乞亞海盜的快速帆船襲擾羅馬運輸線，羅馬則以艦隊護航並封鎖東岸港口。
kitsEn: The card shows a Qin repeating crossbow, a late Warring States Chinese mechanism of about 200 BC, a little more than three centuries older than the Sicilian rising. Its construction stores the pull of the bow in the lock, so that once the weapon is spanned a pressure on the trigger releases one bolt, and a magazine holding several or even several dozen bolts can be fed through for shot after shot. The reason this piece is set against this war is that it marks the place the weapon occupied in its own system: it is neither a battlefield arm nor an anti-armour device, but a siege-defence instrument mounted on the rampart and dedicated to holding down the assault troops crawling up the wall, laying a continuous shower of bolts over the base of the curtain so as to seal the approach of the ladders and the siege towers. Chinese siege reasoning listed the repeating crossbow together with barricades, parapets and stone missiles, and valued rate of fire and endurance rather than the piercing power of a single shot, which is exactly the line of thought a state fought around its city walls would develop. Sicily had no such machine. What the rebels and the Romans actually used was a different set: the slaves had estate tools, sharpened stakes, fish spears, hunting spears, horn-tipped javelins and farm ironware, and the best of it was the armoury seized from the gladiator schools of Messana; the island's tradition of the sling was present on both sides, and the Roman army carried organised slingers. The Roman infantry had the full kit: heavy pilum with the round shield, spear-and-scutum troops, the short sword, helmets and mail; at sieges they used ballistae, stone-throwers and counterweight torsion engines, and during the siege of Agrigentum artillery fire against the walls and against the buildings inside was one of the main tools. Both sides ran their supplies by sea: the rebels used the fast sailing vessels of the Cilician pirates to harry Roman shipping, and Rome replied with escorting warships and a blockade of the eastern ports.
tactics: 起義方用的是一套典型的「起於市集、終於攻城」的戰法。公元前135年最先奪械成功，靠的是人多、看守分散、又正集中在浴場市集周邊這一個可乘之機：奴工先解決看守與打手，奪得角鬥場與守備的兵器，然後不留在城裡與羅馬駐軍硬拼，而是以數百人退入墨西拿東南的塔羅山脈，利用山地、峽谷與陡峭牧道保持主動，再以小股夜襲破壞莊園、摧毀壓榨勞動者的器械，逐步壯大隊伍。奇里乞亞海盜加入後，戰術從陸上騷擾擴展為海上打擊：襲擊羅馬的糧船與運兵船，使援軍的登陸與補給遲滯；城外的起義軍則嘗試對被圍的城邑進行解圍。羅馬方面的戰術與之相反：援軍抵達後不急於深入內陸，而是先取陶羅梅尼翁這類關鍵據點，切斷起義軍的南北往來，再用海陸兩面封鎖，把戰線壓向西南的丘陵地帶；圍阿格里真圖姆時築起環形營壘，調集砲隊對城牆射擊，同時以騎兵巡邏切斷城內守軍與外界的聯絡，最終以封鎖加強攻、加上招撫分化收束殘局。整場戰爭的關鍵是補給線：起義方靠劫掠莊園維持，一旦莊園被清空便難以為繼；羅馬方靠墨西拿的海運，一旦海運被騷擾便寸步難行，勝負始終懸在這兩條線上。
tacticsEn: The rebels used a method typical of risings that begin in a market and end at a city wall. The opening success of 135 BC came from the fact that the number of slaves was large, the guards were scattered, and they were concentrated in one place that could be seized: the bath-house district where those awaiting sale were kept. The runaways first disposed of the overseers and the enforcers, took the weapons of the gladiator schools and of the guard, and then did not stay in the city to trade blows with the Roman detachment. With a few hundred men they withdrew into the Tauro mountains south-east of Messana, keeping the initiative through broken country, ravines and steep shepherd paths, and then grew their numbers with small night raids that broke up the estates and destroyed the instruments of labour. Once the Cilician pirates joined, the method widened from land harassment to a war at sea: Roman grain ships and troop transports were attacked, which delayed the landing and the resupply of the relief force, and the rebels outside the walls attempted to raise the besieged cities. The Roman method was the mirror image. On arrival the relief force did not push inland at once; it first seized key points such as Tauromenium, cut the north-south movement of the rebels, and closed the sea and land routes so as to press the fighting towards the hills of the south-west. Around Agrigentum they built a ring of camps, brought up the artillery to shoot at the curtain, and used cavalry patrols to sever the besieged garrison's contact with the countryside, closing the matter with blockade, assault and offers of amnesty to those who would lay down their arms. Supply was the hinge of the whole war: the rebels lived off the plunder of the estates and, once the estates were stripped, could not go on; Rome lived off the sea route out of Messana and could not advance when that route was harried. The issue was decided on these two lines.
data: 關於兵力與數字，現存史料留下的是零碎而且互相矛盾的紀錄。阿庇安《內戰史》說最初脫逃者約九百人，多為奇里乞亞與亞該亞出身；狄奧多羅斯提到起義隊伍在擴張期達到數萬之眾，但這類數字在轉述中常被放大，可靠性有限，較穩妥的說法是起義方在島東南集結了足以與羅馬軍團正面對抗的兵力。時間線則相當清楚：前135年起事，前134年西西里總督曼利烏斯陣亡、大法官魯皮利烏斯率援軍抵達並攻下陶羅梅尼翁，前133年戰事轉入圍城與清剿，前132年阿格里真圖姆陷落、埃努斯被俘，戰爭歷時約四年。距離方面，起義方據點多在距海岸數十里的山間，羅馬援軍的主要基地是墨西拿與東岸港口，圍城戰中雙方最近的接觸常在城牆矢程之內。物資可以確定的是：羅馬援軍中至少包含一個常備軍團，另有西西里本地駐軍與輔助兵；西西里自第二次布匿戰爭後接收了大量戰俘奴工，這是起義爆發的物質基礎；戰後羅馬把主力常駐在義大利南端的布魯丁西烏姆，這支駐軍後來成為第二次奴隸起義時對付起義的骨幹。凡涉及精確傷亡數字，史料多互相矛盾，本卡不取任何單一數字為準。
dataEn: On numbers, what survives is fragmentary and mutually contradictory. Appian's Civil Wars gives the original runaways as about nine hundred, mostly Cilician and Achaean; Diodorus speaks of the rebel force in the tens of thousands at the height of its expansion, but such figures tend to be inflated in the course of transmission and are of limited reliability, and the safer statement is that the rebels on the south-east of the island mustered a force able to meet a Roman legion in the field. The chronology, by contrast, is clear: the revolt began in 135 BC; in 134 BC the governor Manlius was killed and the praetor Rupilius landed with reinforcements and took Tauromenium; in 133 BC the war settled into siege and mopping-up; in 132 BC Agrigentum fell, Eunus was taken alive, and the war had run for roughly four years. As for distances, the rebel strongholds lay in the hills tens of miles from the coast, while the Roman base of operations was Messana and the eastern ports, and in the siege the two sides most often came within bowshot of the walls. On materiel one can be firm: the Roman relief included at least one regular legion, supported by the garrison in Sicily and by auxiliary troops; Sicily had absorbed a great mass of war captives since the Second Punic War, and that was the material basis of the rising; after the war Rome established a permanent garrison at Brundisium in southern Italy, and that garrison later became the backbone of the suppression of the second servile war. As for exact casualty figures the ancient accounts contradict one another, and no single number is taken as authoritative here.
cause: 起義的起因可以分三層來看。最表層是直接導火線：公元前135年梅西納城裡一批等待販賣的奴工集中在浴場周邊待售，聚集人數多、看守鬆散，消息一旦走漏便極易成事。第二層是奴隸制度的結構性壓力：西西里在第二次布匿戰爭後成為羅馬共和國最富的大莊園區之一，土壤集中於少數大地主手中，勞動主力是戰俘奴工；前241年羅馬兼併西西里後大批迦太基戰俘被賣為奴，工坊、礦場與鹽田的勞動強度極高，而奴工的流動性與同鄉網絡使起義能迅速擴散。第三層是羅馬自身的注意力被牽制：前135年前後，羅馬正把主力放在西班牙戰線，準備應付即將全面爆發的努曼西亞戰爭，元老院對西西里急報的反應遲緩，駐島部隊既缺員又缺指令，這正是曼利烏斯被引到埋伏中陣亡、援軍拖延數個戰季的直接背景。還有一層常被忽略：迦太基戰爭留下的記憶與被販運者的怨恨，使羅馬的秩序在島上並不穩固，一個足夠小的火星就能引燃大片莊園。
causeEn: The origins of the revolt can be read on three levels. The outermost is the spark: in 135 BC a batch of slaves awaiting sale in Messana was concentrated around the bath-houses, large in number and loosely guarded, and once the news spread it was very easy to act. The second level is the structural pressure of slavery: after the Second Punic War Sicily had become one of the richest latifundia regions of the Roman Republic, with the soil concentrated in the hands of a few great proprietors and the labour supplied for the most part by enslaved prisoners of war; after Rome took over Sicily in 241 BC large numbers of Carthaginian captives were sold into bondage, the working conditions in the workshops, the mines and the salt pans were extremely harsh, and the mobility of the enslaved together with their networks of shared origin allowed the rising to spread fast. The third level is that Rome's own attention was drawn elsewhere: around 135 BC the bulk of Roman effort lay in Spain, preparing for the Numantine war that was about to break out in earnest, and the senate's response to the appeals from Sicily was slow, while the troops on the island lacked both men and orders, which is the direct background to Manlius being drawn into an ambush and to the relief taking several campaigning seasons to arrive. One more layer is often overlooked: the memory of the Carthaginian wars and the resentment of the people being sold across the sea meant that Roman order was never secure on the island, and a spark small enough could set whole estates alight.
impact: 平叛之後的直接影響集中在西西里的土地與勞動結構上。大型莊園的奴工來源被切斷，島上田莊難以再以戰俘集中經營，羅馬開始把土地分給一批小農與退伍老兵，過去被莊園主集中佔有的耕地部分被重新分配；阿格里真圖姆等城市的城內格局在圍城之後重建。這種調整在政治上很快被利用：公元前133年上台的護民官提比留斯·森普羅尼奧·格拉庫斯所提土地法，其背景之一正是行省土地被大地主集中、而自由農民與小地主流落這一局面。另一條影響線在義大利：羅馬把遠征軍隊長期駐紮在布魯丁西烏姆，建立起海上的常備據點，這套做法在第二次奴隸起義時被證明有效，也讓羅馬在後來對付地中海海盜與東方強權時多了一個南方支點。對西西里社會而言，起義證明羅馬的鎮壓機器有效但代價高昂，奴隸來源枯竭迫使莊園改用佃農經營，島上公民與外來人口之間的裂痕則被重新劃定。長期看，這場戰爭是羅馬共和國晚期危機的早期徵候之一：奴隸制、勞役、行省剝削與土地集中四個問題在幾十年內相繼爆發。
impactEn: The immediate consequences of the suppression fell on the land and labour structure of Sicily. The supply of enslaved labour to the great estates was cut off, the island could no longer be worked on the concentrated captive-labour model, and Rome began to allot land to smallholders and to discharged veterans, so that part of the arable ground formerly held in a few hands was redistributed; the layout of cities such as Agrigentum was rebuilt after the siege. This adjustment was quickly used in politics: the agrarian law proposed by the tribune of the plebs Tiberius Sempronius Gracchus, who took office in 133 BC, had among its backgrounds exactly this picture of provincial land falling into few hands while free farmers and small proprietors sank. A second line of effect ran through Italy: Rome quartered the expeditionary army permanently at Brundisium, creating a standing maritime base; the practice proved itself in the second servile war and gave Rome a southern pivot for its later campaigns against the Mediterranean pirates and against the eastern powers. For Sicilian society, the rising showed that Rome's machine of suppression worked but at a price; the drying up of the slave supply pushed the estates towards tenancy, and the fault line between citizens and foreign inhabitants was drawn again. In the long run this war is one of the early symptoms of the late Republican crisis: slavery, debt servitude, the exploitation of the provinces and the concentration of land all came to the surface within a few decades.
result: 結果是羅馬共和國以武力取得了完整的勝利，但代價與後續處理同樣明顯。公元前132年，大法官普布利烏斯·魯皮利烏斯在陶羅梅尼翁與阿格里真圖姆兩役中切斷了起義軍的戰略空間，圍城之後城內守軍與城外援軍相繼崩潰，首領被逐一清算：克利昂被羅馬軍隊抓住並處死，梅加魯斯在絕境中自盡，埃努斯在山中被自己人出賣、於一處洞穴中被生擒，隨後被押往羅馬處決，其首級被送回西西里示眾。追捕殘部與收繳兵器持續到前132年底，起義的組織與武裝在島上被徹底拆散，莊園主得以重新取得對勞動力的控制，但奴工來源已被切斷，遂轉向佃農經營。殘局階段最持久的制度性結果，是羅馬在南義大利布魯丁西烏姆留下的常駐軍營；這支部隊與西西里島的守備、羅馬的海上封鎖能力一起，構成了下一次奴隸起義爆發時羅馬必須依賴的鎮壓骨幹。就兵器而言，這場戰爭沒有任何一方使用弩機一類的連發器械，島上守城依靠的是投石索手與拋石，守方的箭矢與投射物多屬消耗品；卡面的秦連弩則提醒人，當一座城牆成為主戰場時，能連續射擊的守城器械才具有決定性的價值——這是中國城防思想在另一個文明裡從未落地的一條路。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Roman victory, but the cost and the handling of the aftermath were equally visible. In 132 BC the praetor Publius Rupilius, through the two actions at Tauromenium and Agrigentum, cut the strategic space of the rebels apart; after the siege the garrison inside and the relief force outside collapsed in turn, and the leaders were settled one by one: Cleon was taken by the Roman soldiers and executed, Megarus killed himself in his extremity, and Eunus was betrayed by his own people, caught alive in a cave and afterwards taken to Rome for execution, his head sent back to Sicily as a warning. The mopping-up and the collection of arms continued through 132 BC, the organisation and the weapons of the revolt were broken up completely on the island, and the proprietors recovered control of their labour, but the source of slaves had been cut off, so the estates turned to tenant farming. The most durable institutional result of the aftermath was the standing camp Rome left at Brundisium in southern Italy; that garrison, together with the Sicilian garrison and Rome's power to blockade the sea, formed the backbone on which Rome had to rely when the next servile war broke out. As for weapons, no side in this war used a repeating mechanism of the crossbow type; island sieges were defended by slingers and stone-throwers, and the defenders' arrows and missiles were consumables. The card's Qin repeating crossbow instead makes the point that when a rampart becomes the battlefield, the siege-defence instrument that can fire without pause is what carries decisive value, a line of development that Chinese fortification thinking pursued and which was never to take root in another civilisation.
